description: 3dfier converts two-dimensional geographic polygons and elevation point clouds into a three-dimensional city surface. Its own README describes semantic lifting of buildings, roads and water polygons and triangulation into a connected digital surface model. The JOSS paper names wind, noise, air-pollution and temperature simulations as downstream users. Spatial coverage is the input city or district and temporal coverage follows the source map and elevation survey. The public repository reports GPL-3.0. A modeller can use the output as urban geometry for microclimate or hazard simulations. A caveat is that model quality depends on source polygons, point density, semantic classes and geometric repair. A watertight mesh does not verify building heights or simulation boundary conditions. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article and own repository were read without downloading city data or generating a mesh.
name: 3dfier three-dimensional city reconstruction
